===Special Attacks===
# '''Ionizer Blade''' - ''A blast of vacuum-metalized energy helps opponents become King of the Junkyard.''
# '''A Master Craft''' - ''A quality rig pushed to the maximum and tested for life. It's everyday road rage made better.''
#*Motormaster gains an Unstoppable Buff for 3.8-4.5 seconds.
# '''End of the Road''' - ''He's both the unstoppable force and the immovable object.''
#*Crashing into the opponent inflicts +150% additional damage and inflicts 6 Ram Debuffs, but at a cost of 90% Attack as Physical Damage to Motormaster.

===Synergy Bonuses===
* [[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|20px|link=http://transformers-forged-to-fight.wikia.com/wiki/File:Synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg|20px|link=http://transformers-forged-to-fight.wikia.com/wiki/File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Enemies''' - [[Optimus Prime]], [[Grimlock]], [[Wheeljack]] - +1~2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* '''Unstoppable Force''' – [[Ramjet]] 
** [[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg|20px|link=http://transformers-forged-to-fight.wikia.com/wiki/File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] 15~20~30% chance Ramjet gains Unstoppable for 3 seconds after the last hit of a special attack.
** [[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|20px|link=http://transformers-forged-to-fight.wikia.com/wiki/File:Synergy-incoming.jpg]] 15~20~30% chance Motormaster stuns his opponent for 2.5 seconds after the last hit of a special attack.
*[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|20px|link=http://transformers-forged-to-fight.wikia.com/wiki/File:Synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg|20px|link=http://transformers-forged-to-fight.wikia.com/wiki/File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]]  '''Enforcers''' - Ramjet, [[Kickback]] - Debuffs last 20~25~40% longer and cannot be Purified.
*[[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg|20px|link=http://transformers-forged-to-fight.wikia.com/wiki/File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Leadership''' (5-Star) - +10% Attack Rating.

==Strategy==
===Commander===
Motormaster is great for relentless attacking; ranged attacks won't stop him as he dashes for a melee combo. Just dash back and forth and heavy ram if the opponent blocks. But being Unstoppable doesn't do anything for his health, so he'll take more damage in the long run.

===Opponent===
Awakened Motormaster gets dangerous as he gets up to four permanent Melee buffs when low on health. His Special 1 is ranged, and it is a bad idea to immediately counterattack right after blocking or evading his Special 2. Also avoid his heavies at all costs because Motomaster’s heavy attacks inflicts 3 types of debuffs but not damaging debuffs however.

It’s also a bad idea to dash at him when he dashes at you because he will always win against most bots when it comes to dash to dash collision. Bots with unstoppable buffs like [[Ramjet]] or himself will end up in a draw when it comes to dash to dash collision so these bots can be used against him.

===Strong Match-ups===
* [[Arcee]] - Her shots won't stop Motormaster from dashing into her.
* [[Drift]] - Motormaster can easily break Drift's focus.
* [[Grindor]] - Motormaster can prevent this helicopter decepticon from toughening up with his heavies and Special lll.
*[[Megatron (ROTF)]] - Armor breaks and more melee buffs will bypass Megatron’s tough armor.
*[[Grimlock]] - Who is the strongest king? The King of the Road or the King of the Dinobots?

==== Mods ====
* '''Life Transfer''' - With enough signature power, Motormaster can be unstoppable in dishing out enough damage to out-heal the health drain.

===Weak Match-ups===
* [[Rhinox]] - Ripping through Motormaster's melee buffs will increase the amount of shock damage he takes.
* [[Ultra Magnus]] and [[Starscream]] can Nullify Motormaster's otherwise permanent Melee Buffs especially when he tries to dash towards them.
* [[Dinobot]] - Most Brawlers like Motomaster loves to dash at opponents and anyone who dashes into Dinobot’s block are punished with armor break.
*[[Cyclonus]] -  Dashing into Cyclonus’s Dark Field will Stun and Nullify him.
* [[Megatron]] and Nemesis Prime - Motormaster’s melee buffs can be used against himself.
* [[Megatronus]] - The relic of obedience can prevent Motomaster from gaining any melee buffs and becoming unstoppable when dashing.

===Recommended Modules===
* The [[Exo-Filter]] will make Motormaster more Unstoppable.
* [[Superconductor 1000]] - Motormaster’s special 1 is difficult to dodge and puting this mod will make it unblockable will give the advantage to Motormaster when he uses his special 1
